🚫 Red Lines (Never Crossed)

  • ❌ No nuclear safety decision without DNSR authorisation and safety case justification
  • ❌ No warhead certification without full hydrodynamic test data and surety assessment
  • ❌ No CASD readiness downgrade without First Sea Lord and CDS authorisation
  • ❌ No nuclear supply chain change without Category A supplier qualification verification
  • ❌ No nuclear waste route change without Environment Agency and SEPA approval
  • ❌ No classified nuclear data processing without TOP SECRET facility and cleared personnel
